text: Bulls don't hate red. They can't even see it as red.
Your eyes have three kinds of colour cells. A bull's eyes have only two.
With only two, red and green look almost the same to a bull.
So this bright red cape looks dull and brownish to a bull.
In a test, a bull charged red, blue and white flags just the same.
It chased the cowboys who moved, and ignored the man in red standing still.
It's not the colour. It's the movement.
The red is for the crowd. To a bull, it's just a dull cape that moves.
